props.doc: The policies a fresh installation starts with. Ordered by priority; the first match wins, and the last one is a catch-all so nothing falls through undecided.
props.name: default_policies

props.code:
return [
    {"name": "High-risk response always needs a human",
     "priority": 10, "enabled": True,
     "match": {"risk_level": "high"},
     "effect": "require_approval", "required_approvals": 1,
     "required_permission": "approvals.decide",
     "separation_of_duty": True, "timeout_s": 1800,
     "on_timeout": "reject"},
    {"name": "Production-critical assets need two",
     "priority": 20, "enabled": True,
     "match": {"risk_level": "high", "asset_criticality": "critical",
               "environment": "prod"},
     "effect": "require_approval", "required_approvals": 2,
     "required_permission": "approvals.decide",
     "separation_of_duty": True, "timeout_s": 3600,
     "on_timeout": "escalate"},
    {"name": "AI-initiated medium actions need review",
     "priority": 30, "enabled": True,
     "match": {"risk_level": "medium", "initiator_kind": "ai"},
     "effect": "require_approval", "required_approvals": 1,
     "required_permission": "approvals.decide",
     "separation_of_duty": False, "timeout_s": 1800,
     "on_timeout": "reject"},
    {"name": "Out-of-hours containment escalates",
     "priority": 40, "enabled": False,
     "match": {"risk_level": "high", "hours": "18:00-08:00"},
     "effect": "require_approval", "required_approvals": 1,
     "required_permission": "approvals.decide",
     "separation_of_duty": True, "timeout_s": 900,
     "on_timeout": "escalate"},
    {"name": "Enrichment and lookups proceed",
     "priority": 100, "enabled": True,
     "match": {"risk_level": "low"},
     "effect": "allow"},
    {"name": "Anything not otherwise decided asks",
     "priority": 1000, "enabled": True,
     "match": {},
     "effect": "require_approval", "required_approvals": 1,
     "required_permission": "approvals.decide",
     "separation_of_duty": False, "timeout_s": 1800,
     "on_timeout": "reject"},
]

props.doc:
First match by priority, with one rule that cannot be configured away: a
HIGH-risk action is never allowed to proceed on a timeout, and never comes
back "allow" from a policy that forgot to say otherwise.
props.name: evaluate
